content.title: About
content.content: Sugar‑free cookie is a light, crunchy wafer made from whole grains, plant oils and sugar substitutes. It contains no added sugar but retains a mildly sweet taste thanks to natural sweeteners.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Sugar‑free wafers are popular in diet plans and for people with diabetes.
Common sweeteners include stevia, erythritol or monk fruit extract.
The crisp texture is achieved by rapid baking at high temperature.
Products are often fortified with B‑vitamins and minerals such as iron and zinc.
Individually wrapped portions make calorie control convenient.

items.title: Low glycemic index
items.content: Absence of added sugar helps maintain stable blood glucose levels.

items.title: Rich in dietary fiber
items.content: Whole‑grain ingredients provide fiber that supports healthy digestion.

items.title: Beneficial fats
items.content: Plant oils supply monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fatty acids beneficial for heart health.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: Fortification with B‑vitamins and minerals aids energy metabolism and immune function.

items.title: Weight‑management support
items.content: Low calorie density and lack of sugar make it suitable for weight‑control diets.

items.title: Allergy to ingredients
items.content: Formulations may contain nuts, soy or gluten, which require caution for allergic individuals.

items.title: Artificial sweeteners
items.content: Some sugar substitutes can cause gastrointestinal discomfort when consumed in large amounts.

items.title: Calorie overconsumption
items.content: Although sugar‑free, the product still provides calories from fats and carbs.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Sugar‑free cookie can be enjoyed as a snack, added to yogurt, smoothies, or used in desserts as a substitute for regular wafers. Pairing with protein sources helps prolong satiety.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in a sealed package in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. For extended shelf life, store in the refrigerator to preserve crispness.
